checkName: Costs, Charges and Value of the Recommendation
appliesTo: All advised investment and pension cases

queries.text: summary of plan charges annual recurring charges our charges

triggerProbe.presentWhen: The report contains a costs and charges section or table.
triggerProbe.absentWhen: No costs or charges are disclosed anywhere in the report.

queryGroups.requirement: All material costs disclosed — product, platform, fund, transaction, advice

queries.text: platform charge product charge percentage per annum on the recommended plan
fund ongoing charges figure OCF investment management charge
transaction costs of the underlying funds excluded from these figures
queries.note: Transaction costs are the most commonly omitted layer; retrieve the exclusion wording as well as any figure.

queries.text: discretionary fund manager charge DFM model portfolio management fee
total annual charge combining platform investment and adviser fees all in cost
queries.note: Tests aggregatedTotalDisclosed. A 'total' that omits the adviser fee is not an aggregated total.

queries.text: illustration charges schedule effect of charges on the projected value

comparison.tolerance: Every cost layer present in the illustration or factsheets must appear in the report.
falsePositiveGuards: A stated exclusion (transaction costs excluded, with reasons) is a disclosure, not an omission — but record it as excluded rather than disclosed.
Charge figures in an illustration may include the adviser fee while the report's table excludes it; reconcile the basis before flagging.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern: no charges disclosed on an advised investment case.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: charge figures asserted with no illustration or factsheet to support them.

queryGroups.requirement: Initial and ongoing adviser fees, consistent with the client agreement

queries.text: our charges initial advice fee percentage of the amount invested in monetary terms
ongoing service fee per annum based on the value of your investments
client agreement fee tariff initial and ongoing charging structure
queries.note: The only place the agreed fee basis can be verified. Category A is named in the matrix specifically for this comparison.

queries.text: how the adviser fee will be paid facilitated from the product or paid directly
VAT treatment of the advice fee

comparison.tolerance: Percentages must match the client agreement exactly; monetary amounts must be that percentage of the stated investment.
falsePositiveGuards: Agreements often state a maximum; a lower charged rate is compliant, a higher one is not.
The monetary fee moves with the transfer value — check the stated basis before treating a difference as an error.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: fees charged with no client agreement on file establishing the basis.

queryGroups.requirement: Cumulative impact of costs and charges

queries.text: reduction in yield effect of charges over the term critical yield
projected value at retirement age at low mid and high growth rates
effect of switching on the maturity value decrease over the term
cumulative effect of charges on your investment returns over time

falsePositiveGuards: Illustration growth rates are prescribed and will differ from cashflow assumptions; that is not an inconsistency by itself.
Real-terms and nominal projections are not comparable — check which basis each figure uses.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern: cumulative impact is explicitly named by this check and is the clearest expression of long-term cost.

queries.text: comparison of the annual recurring charge of the existing plan against the recommended alternative
like for like cost comparison the new plan is cheaper or more expensive than your current plans
existing plan charges annual management charge policy fee from the provider
cost comparison of alternative providers and products considered in research

comparison.tolerance: Each existing-plan charge in the comparison table must match the provider documentation and be arithmetically consistent with the plan's value.
falsePositiveGuards: Recompute: a monetary charge that is not the stated percentage of the stated plan value indicates transposed or erroneous rows.
Comparisons on different bases (with and without adviser fees) are both legitimate; check which basis each conclusion uses before calling it a contradiction.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: existing charges quoted with no provider documentation.

queries.text: what you receive in return for these charges benefits of the ongoing service
the plan would need to outperform by in order to justify the additional cost
past performance of the recommended funds compared with the existing funds
client income expenditure savings and rate of income tax recorded in the fact find
queries.note: Fair value is relative to the client's means, and the marginal rate decides the tax consequence of any encashment the recommendation relies on.

falsePositiveGuards: An assertion that required outperformance 'is achievable' is a claim, not an analysis; require supporting performance data before accepting it.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern under PRIN 2A.4 where the recommendation increases cost.

queryGroups.requirement: Costs are excessive relative to the benefits provided

queries.text: the recommended plan is more expensive than the existing arrangement including our fees
initial fee in monetary terms deducted from the transferred funds
queries.note: Compare the initial fee against the annual saving claimed for the switch; the payback period is the core fair-value test.

falsePositiveGuards: A higher cost is not automatically poor value — test against the stated benefits before concluding.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: No finding where the recommendation reduces cost and the comparison is evidenced.

queryGroups.requirement: Alternatives provide better cost or benefit to the client

queries.text: cheaper alternative available but not recommended reason
cost of leaving the existing plan in place and switching funds internally

falsePositiveGuards: A cheaper option rejected for evidenced non-cost reasons (fund range, access, servicing) is a valid outcome.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Assess on the report alone; note that no comparative cost research was available.

decision.noIssue: Every material cost layer is disclosed or explicitly excluded with reasons, adviser fees match the client agreement, cumulative impact and a cost comparison are present and arithmetically sound, and the benefits are set against the cost.
decision.potentialConcern: A cost layer is silently omitted, no aggregated total is given, charge figures do not reconcile with plan values or provider documentation, adviser fees differ from the client agreement, or a cost increase is unexplained.
decision.notApplicable: Not applicable — this check applies to all advised investment and pension cases.
severityHints: Highest: a charge figure that is arithmetically impossible against the stated plan value, or fees exceeding the client agreement.
High: no aggregated all-in cost, or cumulative impact never shown.
High: the report claims a cost saving that its own comparison table contradicts.
Moderate: transaction costs excluded with reasons but never estimated.
Low: rounding differences between the report table and the illustration.
